# Level 40

> Modern Dubai café offering chef-driven Arabian cuisine, weekly and monthly meal plans, à la carte QR ordering, and a curated yoga & wellness shop — one home for a healthier life in Dubai.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Level 40 — food, meal plans and wellness.
- [About](/about): Story, values and the team behind Level 40.
- [Menu & Order](/menu): Browse the full menu and place dine-in, pickup or table QR orders.
- [Shop](/shop): Yoga mats, accessories, activewear and wellness essentials.
- [Meal Plans](/subscription): Weekly and monthly chef-curated meal subscriptions delivered across Dubai.
- [Services](/services): Ways to enjoy Level 40 — dine-in, pickup, events and more.
- [Journal](/blog): Recipes, kitchen notes and stories from Level 40.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos of the room, plates and people.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, hours, phone and map for the JVC café.
